---

## How to fetch URLs for `trello.com` on VirusTotal

### 1. Build the request URL

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/trello.com/urls
```

### 2. Add query parameters

| Parameter | Description | Example |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `limit`   | Number of results per page (max 100). | `limit=20` |
| `cursor`  | Pagination cursor returned by a previous request. | `cursor=tr_cursor1` |

So the full endpoint becomes:

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/trello.com/urls?limit=20&cursor=tr_cursor1
```

### 3. Set the HTTP headers

```http
GET /api/v3/domains/trello.com/urls?limit=20&cursor=tr_cursor1 HTTP/1.1
Host: www.virustotal.com
Accept: application/json
x-apikey: tr_key001
```

> **Tip:** Replace `tr_key001` with your real API key. Keep it secret!

### 4. Make the request

You can use `curl`, Postman, or any HTTP client in your preferred programming language.

#### Example with `curl`

```bash
curl -X GET \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/trello.com/urls?limit=20&cursor=tr_cursor1" \
     -H "x-apikey: tr_key001" \
     -H "Accept: application/json"
```

### 5. Interpret the response

A successful response will look something like this (simplified):

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "https://trello.com/board/abc123",
      "attributes": {
        "url": "https://trello.com/board/abc123",
        "last_analysis_stats": { ... },
        ...
      }
    },
    ...
  ],
  "links": {
    "next": "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/trello.com/urls?cursor=tr_cursor2"
  }
}
```

- `data` contains up to 20 URL objects.
- `links.next` gives you the cursor (`tr_cursor2`) for the next page.

### 6. Handle pagination

If you need more than 20 URLs, repeat the request using the cursor from `links.next`. Continue until you’ve collected all the URLs you need or until `links.next` is absent.

---

## Quick checklist

- ✅ Verify you have a valid API key (`tr_key001` in your example).
- ✅ Use HTTPS and include the `x-apikey` header.
- ✅ Respect the rate limits (default: 4 requests/minute for free accounts).
- ✅ Store the cursor from `links.next` if you plan to paginate.

---

If you’d like a snippet in Python, JavaScript, or another language, just let me know and I’ll generate it for you.
